breakdown.description: Cost-reimbursement from hotel owners for operating expenses (payroll, IT, etc.); essentially pass-through with no/low margin
Core high-margin revenue: base management fees + franchise fees from 7,500+ properties
Base management fees from managed properties
Incentive management fees tied to property-level profitability
Owned/leased hotel operations and other revenue

segments.business_model_note: Asset-light model — Hilton owns/leases very few properties. ~97% of rooms are managed or franchised. High-margin fee revenue (~$3.5B including all management + franchise) is the economic engine; reimbursement revenue inflates top line but contributes minimal profit.

geographic_breakdown.geographic_notes: Revenue heavily US-concentrated (~79%). International growth is a key strategic lever — Hilton operates in 143 countries/territories as of 2025. US market share ~9% vs global ~6.35%. Asia Pacific and Europe represent underpenetrated regions (~1% market share each).

brand_portfolio.total_properties: 8,300+ (as of year-end 2025, up from 7,530 at year-end 2023)
key_brands: Outset Collection by Hilton (conversion-focused, launched Oct 2025, 60+ hotels in pipeline)
Apartment Collection by Hilton (furnished apartments, launching H1 2026, Placemakr partnership ~3,000 units)
brand_portfolio.luxury_lifestyle_milestone: 1,000+ luxury and lifestyle hotels globally, 200+ added in 2025, ~500 more in pipeline

financial_highlights_2025.revpar_note: Modest RevPAR growth reflects industry-wide deceleration; industry forecast for 2026 is +1-2% RevPAR growth driven by rate rather than occupancy

supply_chain.strategic_focus: Responsible sourcing, waste reduction, sustainable supply chain practices. HSM leverages Hilton's scale for negotiated commercial terms across the global portfolio.

dtc_digital_channels.direct_channel_share: ~75% of overall bookings through direct channels
dtc_digital_channels.web_channel_detail: Web channels represent ~50% of the 75% direct share (~37.5% of total)
dtc_digital_channels.mobile_app_share: 40-50% of web channel traffic from Hilton Honors mobile app
dtc_digital_channels.direct_growth_rate: Web-direct channels grew 3x the rate of all other channels
dtc_digital_channels.loyalty_program: Hilton Honors — used as primary DTC driver with price match guarantee + member discounts
dtc_digital_channels.digital_features: Mobile booking, room selection, digital check-in, Digital Key, mobile check-out

tam.hilton_implied_market_share: Hilton's ~$10.8B revenue = ~0.19% of $5.82T total hospitality TAM; ~6.35% of global branded hotel market (narrower TAM definition)
